text:
Aria Kim: Hey team — first day. Followed the onboarding steps but `kubectl config get-contexts` only shows 'default'. I need a personal dev namespace (aria-dev) to test previews. Who should I ping?

Ben Carter: welcome Aria :wave: Quick checks: did you complete Okta SSO and device enrollment? Run `redwood-sso login --okta` then `kubectl config view --minify --raw` and paste the contexts (sanitized).

Aria Kim: pasted sanitized output:
```
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: redwood-dev
    user: aria@redwood.ai
  name: redwood-dev
```

Ben Carter: that user looks like a raw email instead of the Okta exec user (`okta:aria@redwood.ai`). @oncall-k8s can you check whether Aria is in the Okta group that maps to k8s dev access (k8s-dev-access)?

oncall-k8s: checking... aria@redwood.ai is NOT a member of Okta group k8s-dev-access. Requesting group add.

infra-team-bot: Added aria@redwood.ai to Okta group k8s-dev-access (job-id: grp-add-2026-10-05-01).

Ben Carter: after the group add, re-run `redwood-sso login --okta`. Then test `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n aria-dev`. If you see "You must be logged in to the server" run `redwood-sso doctor`. If it says "no" that's OK until RBAC is applied.

Aria Kim: re-ran SSO and now `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n aria-dev` -> "no" (expected until RBAC applied).

Ben Carter: creating namespace `aria-dev` and a RoleBinding `rb-aria-dev-edit` granting `edit` to `okta:aria@redwood.ai`. Applying now.

oncall-k8s: applied RoleBinding rb-aria-dev-edit in namespace aria-dev. Give it a moment to propagate.

Aria Kim: `kubectl get pods -n aria-dev` -> no resources found. I can list and `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=aria-dev` worked. Port-forward to my dev service succeeds. Thanks y'all! :thumbsup:

Ben Carter: great — adding a short troubleshooting note to the onboarding doc about missing Okta-group mappings and the error string to look for. For CI service accounts later, open a request in #eng-infra with SA name and verbs; we prefer namespaced SAs for dev work.

Aria Kim: awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
